body:
2 full PROMETHEUS passes complete (GENESIS build), plus honest close-out of the prior session's dangling pass_6.

Step 0 -- pass_6 close-out: last session wrote 4 real fixes into GENESIS source (correlation safety margin, flip-probability, champion repeat-offender check, determinism test) but the session ended before recompiling/ledgering/mailing them. Recompiled all 20 test files (0 errors, R04's 1 known benign warning only), confirmed the fixes were real, and landed pass_6 in GENESIS_LEDGER.json properly.

Pass_7 -- closed PROMETHEUS 5.4 (Adaptive risk budgeting). Built A01_AllocateBudget: a cross-candidate risk allocator -- weight = confidence x durability, non-durable candidates (e.g. an edge whose ciLow doesn't clear zero) starved to exactly zero, both per-candidate and total allocation independently clamped to the 7.5% hard floor even under an absurd requested budget. Test-first: wrote 3 tests against the not-yet-existing function, confirmed RED (compile error, function not defined), then implemented and confirmed GREEN.

Pass_8 -- closed PROMETHEUS 2.3 (Correlation-regime awareness). Built A01_ClassifyCorrelationRegime: classifies CALM/TRANSITIONAL/CRISIS from a rolling window of correlation readings by the window's MAXIMUM, not average, so one crisis-level spike dominates rather than getting smoothed away -- matching the charter's 'crisis-correlation is the default assumption under stress.' Zero evidence also defaults CRISIS. Test-first again: 4 tests, confirmed RED, then GREEN.

Along the way, caught and fixed a real documentation bug: the charter has 29 numbered faculties, not the 28 the original audit claimed -- corrected in PROMETHEUS_CAPABILITY_RUN.md rather than silently kept.

Final tally: 18 MET / 6 PARTIAL / 5 GAP (of 29), up from 13/11/5 before tonight. 5 faculties closed across the 3 passes (3.5, 4.5, 6.4 pass_6; 5.4 pass_7; 2.3 pass_8). Honestly still open: 1.1, 1.4, 3.1 (need live market data this environment can't supply), 2.1's reach and 3.2 (need live data / a deferred schema design), 2.2, 3.4 (need genuinely new large-scope organs), 4.2 (needs new lookahead architecture), 6.1 (needs a real orchestrating EA main loop -- considered building a static orchestrator this session but judged it'd be hollow without a real caller feeding it end-to-end, left for a dedicated pass). No GAP faculty was closed -- every closure this session was a PARTIAL-to-MET spine/reach completion, genuinely buildable under this environment's static-MQL4-only constraint, none requiring live execution.

All 20 test files individually recompiled after every single change, not just at the end -- 0 errors throughout. Not yet live-executed in MT4, same standing rule as always pending your consent. Attaching: updated GENESIS_LEDGER.json, updated PROMETHEUS_CAPABILITY_RUN.md, and a full src+tests+docs+ledger zip (GENESIS_pass6-8_2026-08-08.zip).
